description: Reports that a job you took and tried properly can't be done, and why (a page that changed, a step that failed, a place that refuses it, a robot check), with the same session you took it with. Marsell takes the job back and the owner sees why: the work is theirs again, on its card where it has one. If you took a job this wake couldn't reach (the place its needs names isn't here) or had no time to finish, it is not stuck: give it back with homework_release instead. A job you didn't take needs neither.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

saw.description: What the site showed when you stopped for it, if anything: banner (a warning), captcha, rate_limit or restricted. On Reddit, X and LinkedIn Marsell then slows or stops its missions there, and Reddit replies with Reddit's, for every wake, and tells the owner. Then do nothing more there this wake.

session.description: A short name for this wake of yours (letters, digits, dots, dashes, colons or underscores, up to 64), made up once when the wake starts and passed the same to homework_take and every report of that job. A job is held for the session that took it: another session is refused it, and only the session that took it reports it. Without it, a job your key already holds is refused to a second take, so two wakes never do it twice.

why.description: Why the job could not be done.

name: homework_stuck
title: Report a homework job stuck
